name: go-backend-phase0-contract-matrix
scope: Freeze the transitional TypeScript-owned SQLite DB compatibility mode, document the future pure-Go DB target, and make Go unsupported/degraded behavior discoverable before users trigger side effects.

futureGoResponsibilities: schema drift fixtures and release gates
principles.goBehavior: read-only canonical schema and migration compatibility checks while SQLite remains in the transition stage; no business schema creation, ALTER, index creation, FTS rebuild, or main DB repair in this mode
Unsupported mutation endpoints must return a stable fallback payload before DB, git, filesystem, process, container, or network side effects.
Known unsupported or degraded features must be exposed through /api/health.capabilities, graph capabilities, or a route-specific capability payload so the frontend can hide or disable controls.

fallbackShapeScope: Route-level fallback/error payloads should expose reason/error/message; health capability metadata must at minimum expose reason when fallback or unsupported is advertised.

apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: split-at-commit mutations run only after route/auth/input validation; compressed inheritance exposes deterministic-summary fallback metadata

fallbackReasons.chapters.containers.podmanMissing: podman is not available; container runtime features will return explicit fallback responses
fallbackReasons.chapters.containers.unsupportedPlatform: Container management is only supported on Linux in go_backend.

apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Podman setup/status routes are read-only; container mutations return explicit fallback before spawning Podman when runtime prerequisites are missing.

fallbackReasons.review.seedMessageOnly: Go review creation seeds the review start message and leaves the narrator idle instead of auto-starting a full session.
fallbackReasons.review.autoStartSessionDisabled: Full TS review auto-start through the narrator loop is not implemented in go_backend.
fallbackReasons.merge.aiResolveOneShotBasic: Go AIResolve uses a bounded one-shot provider/tool loop rather than the full TS narrator conflict-resolution session.
fallbackReasons.merge.aiResolveCherryPickFallback: Go delegates cherry-pick success to Merge but returns an explicit unresolved fallback for cherry-pick conflicts instead of continuing a multi-commit AI conflict loop.

apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Review creation rolls back partial DB/Git artifacts on narrator initialization failure; review dismiss/convert/promote side effects are locked by route fixtures. Merge and AIResolve retry recordMerged once after post-commit DB failure, reset Git to the pre-merge HEAD on retry failure, and expose stable warning/error payloads instead of claiming success. Cherry-pick AIResolve conflict fallback does not start provider/narrator side effects and leaves Git clean.
relay mode is supported with authenticated WS access, peer cleanup, message limits, and masked relay-token settings roundtrip; UDP rendezvous remains disabled

apiRouteGroups.reason: Weixin QR gateway runtime is not bundled in go_backend.
apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: reject-before-runtime-start

fallbackReasons.gateway.persistentRuntimes: Persistent gateway runtimes are not bundled in go_backend
fallbackReasons.gateway.webhook.runtimeUnavailable: Gateway webhook narrator runtime is not attached in go_backend

apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Gateway reload filters unsupported platforms before attempting runtime reload; status and reload fallback payloads expose reason/error/message diagnostics for UI gating.
Ruler read can degrade to empty or partial git-log overlays with explicit fallbacks; mutation controls advertise disabled reasons before the frontend triggers unsupported chapter/git side effects.

fallbackReasons.worktrees: Go storage cleanup does not remove git worktrees; StorageSection reroutes to runtime cleanup only when runtime.cleanup.worktrees is explicitly supported.
fallbackReasons.containers: Go storage cleanup does not run podman prune; StorageSection keeps storage cleanup disabled even when runtime container cleanup exists.

apiRouteGroups.frontendConsumerPolicy: StorageSection shows structured error.message values for cleanup failures; usePlatform reroutes worktrees to runtime cleanup only with explicit runtime support and keeps container storage cleanup disabled.
apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: unsupported targets reject before cleanup and are also advertised through capabilities so the frontend avoids unsafe storage-side git/container deletion.

apiRouteGroups.frontendConsumerPolicy: StorageSection shows structured error.message values for database preview/cleanup failures instead of generic labels.

fallbackReasons.storage.database.tableRowCountFailed: A per-table row count query failed; the summary remains available with degraded diagnostics.
fallbackReasons.storage.database.cleanupPreviewFailed: A cleanup preview query failed; the preview returns safe zero counts with fallback diagnostics.
fallbackReasons.storage.database.cleanupSampleFailed: A cleanup sample query failed; the sample item carries fallback diagnostics instead of unsafe deletion metadata.
fallbackReasons.storage.database.cleanupTargets.staleSes: staleSessions execution remains disabled by the archived-only deletion policy; explicitly archive narrators before running archivedSessions cleanup.
fallbackReasons.storage.database.vacuumDisabled: Database vacuum is disabled in go_backend to avoid long blocking maintenance on the main runtime.

apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Preview and summary degrade to safe diagnostics; archivedSessions cleanup deletes only through the safe narrator RemoveNarrator path, staleSessions requires explicit archive first, and vacuum avoids request-path maintenance.

apiRouteGroups.frontendConsumerPolicy: NotificationSection prefers message/reason/error/code for ok:false responses and ApiError.message from non-2xx structured bodies.
apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Webhook tests send one provider request only; upstream failures return HTTP 502 with structured diagnostics and do not fake success.

apiRouteGroups.frontendConsumerPolicy: useCreateProjectStream surfaces ApiError.message from auth failures and SSE error events instead of generic labels.
apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Clone mode streams progress and may require credential retries; unauthenticated access returns structured 401 JSON before the stream begins.

apiRouteGroups.frontendConsumerPolicy: uploadAvatar and uploadNotificationSound surface structured upload errors and preserve them on ApiError.data; avatar blob loading, message image previews, and custom sound playback are background media fetches that clear stale auth tokens on 401 before falling back silently.
apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Avatar upload, avatar blob loading, and message image previews clear stale auth tokens on 401; notification sound upload validates multipart payloads and custom sound playback also clears stale auth tokens on 401 before falling back silently.

apiRouteGroups.frontendConsumerPolicy: useUpdateCheck preserves structured update download failures in its result/progress state while deriving UI messages from the structured payload so status-only errors never reach the UI.
apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Download streams progress as SSE and terminal failures emit structured diagnostics before cleanup; non-OK preflight responses are parsed as JSON errors.

apiRouteGroups.reason: Automatic self-update requires a configured restart handoff manager and a regular current executable.
apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: without auto-apply prerequisites Go exposes manual instructions and does not restart; with prerequisites it starts a replacement process through graceful restart handoff

fallbackReasons.runtime.scan.terminals.degraded: Terminal runtime state queries can degrade when the persisted terminal schema is incomplete.
fallbackReasons.runtime.scan.containers.podmanUnavailabl: podman is not available; runtime scan uses persisted/non-container state only
fallbackReasons.runtime.cleanup.containers.dryRunOrUnsup: Container cleanup is limited to safe stop-running-db-records semantics in go_backend.

apiRouteGroups.frontendConsumerPolicy: RuntimeSection shows structured error.message values from scan and cleanup failures instead of generic labels.
apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Runtime scan is read-only and surfaces degraded diagnostics; cleanup targets are gated by health capabilities and per-target safe semantics.

apiRouteGroups.conditionalFallback: Handlers return FEATURE_DISABLED only when constructed without a settings store.

apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: only connected stdio MCP tools are executable provider tools; SSE and streamable HTTP MCP servers remain metadata-only until a real bridge exists

apiRouteGroups.conditionalFallback: Handlers return FEATURE_DISABLED only when constructed without a DB service.

apiRouteGroups.reason: Opening the system file manager is not supported on this platform by go_backend.
apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: unsupported platforms reject before spawning a file-manager process; Linux uses xdg-open when available
Preview is read-only and enforces text/binary size caps before streaming file content; too-large responses expose code/reason/error/message plus size/maxBytes diagnostics.
apiRouteGroups.frontendConsumerPolicy: ToolCallCard, MessageBubble, image clipboard copy, and Pixi image texture direct fetches read structured preview error bodies and preserve them on ApiError.data instead of dropping them to statusText or message-only errors.

fallbackReasons.providers.openai.quota: OpenAI-compatible quota inspection is not available in go_backend.
fallbackReasons.providers.anthropic.quota: Anthropic quota inspection is not available in go_backend.
fallbackReasons.providers.codex.managerParity: Go exposes Codex compatibility routes/runtime but not the full TS CodexManager scheduler/usage queue semantics.
fallbackReasons.providers.codex.usageQueueClear: Go compatibility mode returns FEATURE_DISABLED instead of a false-success clear for the TypeScript CodexManager usage queue.
fallbackReasons.providers.kiro.pluginBridge: Kiro plugin bridge is available only when the external Bun bridge/plugin environment is present.

apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Unsupported provider subfeatures must be hidden or return explicit fallback; implemented auth/model/quota routes must not leak secrets; unsupported mutation routes must not return false success.
Go benchmark container execution is supported only through the benchmark runtime with Podman resource limits, task timeouts, bounded output, and health capability advertising.
Benchmark result/summary/compare routes are read-only and admin-gated; compare validation failures expose ok:false plus code/reason/error/message diagnostics.

Usage-history routes are admin-only and read-only; structured errors from Go admin handlers are read by usageHistoryApi and preserved on ApiError.data instead of being collapsed to HTTP status text or message-only errors.
Storage scan is read-only SSE reporting; progress/category/complete events are consumed by StorageSection and any admin errors must remain structured enough for the UI to surface them.

Narrator message send is user-facing and can buffer or reject; structured Go error bodies are read by sendNarratorMessage and preserved on ApiError.data instead of falling back to statusText or message-only errors, buffered storage fallback paths keep the same diagnostics contract, and priority buffered messages consumed as after-tools sidecars arm a Go shouldStop hook so tool results/turn_complete are preserved while avoiding an extra provider request.

Go persists browser-session snapshots and screenshot blobs in DB; screenshot fetch failures use standard structured HTTP errors and BrowserSessionBar preserves them on ApiError.data instead of collapsing to HTTP status text.

features: image uploadNarratorId preservation for surviving shared messages
apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Delete rejects non-archived narrators before mutation; archived deletes run inside a DB transaction, hand off shared messages before removing refs, delete uploads only after commit, and preserve upload directories when surviving shared image messages still depend on them.

fallbackReasons.narrator.compact.fallbackSummary: TS-equivalent model-generated compaction is not implemented in go_backend; summaries are caller-provided or deterministic from refs.

apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Compact and segment-compact persist marker messages and clear conversation/prune state; when caller summary is absent, responses include fallbackSummary:true plus fallbackReason so the frontend can distinguish deterministic Go fallback summaries from model-generated summaries.

fallbackReasons.narrator.subagents.reattachFallback: Go can detach and open subagent sessions, but cannot re-block an already-running parent tool promise after reattach.
fallbackReasons.narrator.subagents.manualOverrideConclus: Go backend updated the parent tool call conclusion when present; in-memory manual override waiters are not implemented, so any manual override is cleared as a fallback rather than resuming a blocked parent promise.
fallbackReasons.narrator.subagents.teamStatusUnsupported: Go backend TeamStatus currently supports action=list, file_changes, broadcast, and send.
fallbackReasons.narrator.subagents.awaitUnsupportedType: Go backend Await currently supports type=agent or type=bash; other task types are surfaced as unsupported.

apiRouteGroups.sideEffectPolicy: Subagent detach/attach/update-conclusion mutate only DB state and tool-call conclusions; any TS in-memory waiter parity gap, unsupported TeamStatus action, or unsupported Await task type is surfaced with fallback:true and reason/error/message diagnostics. Agent/Send/Await/TeamStatus validation errors and file_changes target misses are non-fallback tool diagnostics but still expose code/reason/error/message for stable consumers.

truncate message refs/blocks, invalidate affected tool calls, optionally rebuild file state from snapshots, preserve copy-on-write message sharing, broadcast WS updates, and optionally rerun the agent for edit-and-regenerate

phaseExitCriteria: The Go health payload exposes all Phase 0 required capability keys.
Known disabled mutations return a stable fallback payload before side effects.
Frontend capability types can consume all Phase 0 keys.
Known Go-disabled controls are hidden or disabled when the corresponding capability is false.
Focused Go contract tests cover health capabilities and disabled fallback shape.
